name: identity-layer
body: The ingestor-side component that resolves a source file's canonical identity from the repository-relative base and renders every fqn from it: the File fqn, the language root, and the module/scope rooting. It reads the git toplevel (`rust.apg.git`) and writes the relative identity into the graph (`rust.apg.load`) and the exported jsonl (`rust.apg.ingest.root_module_fqn`). Owns the repo-relative identity of files and modules; absolute paths are reconstructed only in the suite-tool layer.
